subject: Clarify lateral-movement finding & remediation ETA
messages:
From: Jason Smith <jason.smith@thirdparty-pen.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme-logistics.com
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: Initial delivery - external pen test (high: lateral movement)

Hi Ben / Marissa,

Attached is the final external penetration test we ran for Acme Logistics (attached: TPP-External-Pentest-Report-2026-11.pdf). Key item: we validated a chained exploit that allowed lateral movement from the public-facing ingestion host to a staging database via an exposed orchestration port and weak host segmentation controls.

Severity: high (lateral movement enabling access to non-public subsystems).
Observed: compromised host -> pivot via exposed RPC on 10.18.7.22 -> staging DB credentials found in container temp files.

Request: please confirm scope of intended remediation items and ETA for evidence handoff (pooled logs, changed firewall rules, keystore rotation proof). Acme security asked for a brief remediation summary + artifacts within 10 business days.

Attachments: TPP-External-Pentest-Report-2026-11.pdf (PDF, 3.9MB)

Thanks,
Jason
Jason Smith
Principal Tester, ThirdParty Pen
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 07 Dec 2026 08:11:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Initial delivery - external pen test (high: lateral movement)

Forwarding the pen-test to get remediation owners and timelines. Summary: external test shows lateral pivot via exposed orchestration port and secrets in container tmp files. Acme needs evidence within 10 business days from 12/5.

Proposed owners:
- Network/Infra (host segmentation + firewall): Marissa Cole (NET-ops)
- Application secrets / keystore rotation: Laura Bennett (Platform)
- Detection/log evidence (request logs & timeline): Rishi Malhotra (Security)

Marissa / Laura / Rishi — can each confirm owner, high-level fix, and ETA for evidence (packet captures / fw rule changes / keystore rotation artifact) by Tuesday EOD (12/09)? Acme will escalate if we miss the window.

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Dec 2026 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Initial delivery - external pen test (high: lateral movement)

Thanks Ben — owner confirmations below and initial plan: 

1) Network segmentation & orchestration port exposure (owner: Marissa)
- Action: block orchestration RPC (port 2379) at public ingress; apply host-level iptables policy to deny inter-subnet RPC calls; add egress deny for ephemeral orchestration ports.
- Ticket: NET-ops #4287 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/NET-4287)
- ETA for firewall rule change: 12/10 COB.
- Evidence to hand to Acme: pre/post firewall rule diff, syslogs from edge firewall (range 12/08-12/10).

2) Container secrets leakage (owner: Laura)
- Action: rotate staging keystore, remove credentials from container temp volumes, add admission controller check to prevent writing /tmp to persistent volumes; introduce image scan to flag plain-text creds.
- Ticket: PLAT #2159 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PLAT-2159)
- ETA for keystore rotation and initial artifact: 12/12 EOD.
- Evidence: rotation manifest, new keystore entry id, container image digest before/after, sample admission-controller deny logs.

3) Detection / Logging (owner: Rishi)
- Action: backfill host-level audit logs and pull KV-cache access traces; create a short detection rule signature for similar pivot patterns.
- Ticket: SEC-1142 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-1142)
- ETA for first evidence bundle (log extracts + SIEM rule): 12/12 EOD.

I'll post the artifacts to the secure drive once we've collected them. If Acme wants independent verification, we can request a quick re-test with ThirdParty Pen (cost TBD).

–Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Network Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, security@acme-logistics.com
Cc: Jason Smith <jason.smith@thirdparty-pen.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clarify lateral-movement finding & remediation ETA

Ben / all — short status and proposed evidence handoff.

Status snapshot (12/12 16:30 PST):
- NET-4287: firewall rules applied at 12/10 20:16 PST; edge syslog ranges collected and uploaded.
- PLAT-2159: staging keystore rotated 12/12 10:04 PST; container cleanup run 12/12 11:00 PST; admission-controller policy merged to staging.
- SEC-1142: SIEM extracts (12/04-12/12) and host audit slices prepared.

Planned handoff: I uploaded the evidence bundle to a secure drive: https://drive.redwood.com/secure/Acme/pt-evidence-2026-12 (contains: firewall-diff.txt, edge-syslogs-12-08-12-10.gz, keystore-rotation-manifest.json, container-digest-list.txt, siem-extracts-12-04-12-12.tar.gz). For Acme's procurement team, we also have a short remediation write-up summarizing controls changed and scope of impact (remediation-evidence-bundle-2026-12-12.zip attached).

Open items:
- We recommend rotating any staging DB credentials that may have been exposed; Platform to coordinate DB rotation window with SRE next week (PLAT-2164).
- Jason / Acme: if you require an independent re-test we can scope and provide an estimate; otherwise, please confirm if the uploaded artifacts satisfy the evidence request.

Ben — I'll leave it to you to close the loop with Acme (I included Jason on reply so he can validate).

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director of Security, Redwood Inference

Attachments: remediation-evidence-bundle-2026-12-12.zip (ZIP, 12MB)
